author: evacfk
description: Automatically hides long-inactive members behind a Lurker role, stripping their other roles and restoring them when they post in a designated reactivation channel. Posts a weekly digest of flags and restores to a mod channel. Year club: keeps exactly one 'N year club!' role on every active member, swapped on each join anniversary (`.yearclub`).
short: Auto-hide inactive members behind a Lurker role.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores member IDs, role IDs, last-activity timestamps, and display names of members flagged or restored since the last mod report. No message content is stored.
